title: Frontend Intern
description: Help a small product team build thoughtful, accessible web experiences. Turn design ideas into responsive interfaces, improve existing components, and learn through supportive code reviews.

title: API Engineering Intern
description: Learn how reliable services are built. Work with a mentor on small API features, database queries, and automated checks in a friendly engineering team.

title: UI/UX Intern
description: Bring a fresh perspective to everyday product problems. Explore user journeys, prototype ideas, and work with designers to make useful digital products feel effortless.

title: Data Analyst Intern
description: Find the useful story inside a dataset. Clean sample business data, build clear dashboards, and work with an analyst to communicate practical insights.

title: Security Operations Intern
description: Explore defensive security with a mentor in a fictional isolated lab. Review sample logs, learn Linux fundamentals, and document observations clearly. No public systems are tested.
